newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Montreal to fight Bre-X lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Bank Montreal to fight Bre-X lawsuit.

text.p: Bank of Montreal said on Wednesday its wholly owned Nesbitt Burns Inc brokerage would vigorously defend against a lawsuit filed in connection with Bre-X Minerals Ltd 's Busang scandal.

"Nesbitt Burns has built a reputation of integrity and professionalism," said Bank of Montreal spokesman Paul Gammal. "We are satisfied that the firm and our mining analyst acted appropriately and we intend to vigorously defend this or any other claim."
The suit was filed by Windsor, Ontario lawyer Harvey Strosberg, who said in a statement last Friday that it arose from Nesbitt's activities relating to Bre-X.

Nesbitt's star mining analyst Egezio Bianchini wrote "the gold is there" in a research report shortly before Bre-X partner Freeport-McMoran Copper & Gold Inc announced it had found ony insignificant amounts of gold at Bre-X's Busang site in Indonesia. Bre-X's stock collapsed.

Bre-X executives had claimed that Busang contained about 71 million ounces. Later an independent mining company reported there was not enough gold to be worth mining and that it suspected Bre-X's mining samples had been tampered with.
In the fallout Bre-X's stock -- once valued at at over C$6.0 billion -- collapsed to pennies a share and resulting in massive losses for investors.
